summary: acer aspire 5 15 has a balance of performance and affordability, but may experience heat issues if not properly cooled.
detected_fault: Heat throttling due to high-performance GPU (NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4050) without adequate cooling solutions.
suggested_solution: Ensure proper cooling by using a laptop stand or external cooling pad, and consider upgrading the RAM to 32GB or more for future-proofing.
